description: Re-establish an exact, independently verified ggen-ecosystem release crown without inheriting historical standing.

Evaluate and, only when explicitly authorized, close the current release-crown chain for `ggen-ecosystem`.

Start by resolving the exact current repository HEAD and reading `docs/CURRENT-RELEASE-STANDING.md`, `ecosystem.lock.toml`, issue #146, the release receipt, and the mfact certification contract. Historical v26.8.28 execution evidence is lineage evidence only; it must not be promoted into proof that the current capsule is available.

The crown requires one exact subject chain:

1. admitted GGen, Marketplace, gitlink, and ecosystem identities;
2. a successfully published immutable container subject at an observed registry digest;
3. a fresh consumer that pulls that exact digest without relying on a local image cache;
4. a real `ggen sync run` against that exact subject;
5. a receipt binding producer identities, command, exit, consequence, and digest;
6. deterministic replay of the same consequence;
7. the independent certification court applied to the exact resulting subject.

Do not replace a failed registry pull with a local image, substitute a workflow definition for observed execution, or close the crown because an older receipt once passed. Preserve every refusal/failure as evidence, repair only the causal defect, and rerun the same falsifier until it flips.

If DO authority is not explicitly granted, stop at the highest-information executable plan and exact current standing; do not publish or merge.
